definitions.explanation: A tropical storm occurring in the western Pacific Ocean.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{近|ちか}づいている。
{台風|たいふう}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まった。
examples.english: Trains stopped due to the typhoon.

notes: Typhoons are numbered in Japan (台風10号 = Typhoon #10). Typhoon season is typically late summer to autumn.
